# topology

```go
import "github.com/Bugs5382/go-saga-orchestration/topology"
```

Package topology names and declares the RabbitMQ exchanges and queues the engine and its workers share.

The engine publishes every action and compensation dispatch to the direct exchange ExchangeAction with the action's full name as the routing key \(for example "billing.charge"\). A worker declares a durable queue and binds it once per action name with DeclareActionQueue. Direct exchanges match routing keys exactly, so wildcard bindings such as "billing.\*" never match.

## Constants

<a name="ExchangeAction"></a>Exchange and queue names.

```go
const (
    // ExchangeAction is the direct exchange action and compensation
    // dispatches are published to, keyed by action name.
    ExchangeAction = "action.direct"
    // ExchangeWorkflowEvents is the topic exchange emit_event and
    // wait_for_event use.
    ExchangeWorkflowEvents = "workflow.events"
    // QueueSagaAdvance carries saga.advance messages between engine replicas.
    QueueSagaAdvance = "saga.advance"
    // QueueSagaDLQ holds saga.advance messages that could not be processed.
    QueueSagaDLQ = "saga.dlq"
    // QueueActionDLQ holds action dispatches a worker rejected.
    QueueActionDLQ = "action.dlq"
)
```

<a name="Declare"></a>
## func Declare

```go
func Declare(ch Channel) error
```

Declare declares the exchanges and queues the engine owns. It is idempotent.

<a name="DeclareActionQueue"></a>
## func DeclareActionQueue

```go
func DeclareActionQueue(ch Channel, queue string, routingKeys ...string) error
```

DeclareActionQueue declares ExchangeAction, a durable queue, and one exact binding per routing key \(each an action's full name\). It is idempotent.

<a name="Channel"></a>
## type Channel

Channel is the part of \*amqp.Channel the declarations use.

```go
type Channel interface {
    ExchangeDeclare(name, kind string, durable, autoDelete, internal, noWait bool, args amqp.Table) error
    QueueDeclare(name string, durable, autoDelete, exclusive, noWait bool, args amqp.Table) (amqp.Queue, error)
    QueueBind(name, key, exchange string, noWait bool, args amqp.Table) error
}
```
